svg.title: EKS 3-Tier Architecture – 30–40 Node Workload
svg.desc: AWS EKS cluster with internet, ingress, frontend tier, backend tier, data tier, and supporting platform services across 30–40 worker nodes.

g.text: AWS ALB + NGINX ingress controller · TLS termination · WAF · Rate limiting
React/Next.js SSR · Node.js BFF · Redis session cache · CDN offload via CloudFront
Backend / application tier · 14–18 nodes (m6i.4xlarge) · HPA + KEDA
Microservices mesh (Istio) · gRPC + REST · Event-driven workers · Internal service discovery
Istio service mesh · mTLS everywhere · traffic policy · circuit breakers · retries
Data tier · 8–10 nodes (r6i.4xlarge, i4i.4xlarge) · StatefulSets + PVCs
Multi-AZ HA · EBS gp3 / EFS · automated backups · cross-region replication
EBS gp3 (per node) · EFS (shared) · Velero backup · RDS automated snapshots · cross-region replication
Platform / observability · 4–6 dedicated nodes (m6i.2xlarge) · Karpenter autoscaler
Full-stack observability · CI/CD · secrets · policy engine · cluster autoscaling

svg.text: Node group summary · total: 34–45 EC2 worker nodes
